description: Variation of Condition 4 (Energy) following planning permission P/2019/2630 approved 15/07/2020
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from 14/07/2020.

Reason: To accord with provisions of section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. 
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (

Design and Access Statement dated July 2019

Consultation summary dated June 2019, 
Demolition and Construction Management Plan, Daylight and Sunlight report dated 6th June 2019, 

Transport Statement dated 15th July 2019, 

Desktop Utility Search, Planning Statement dated July 2019,

Noise Impact Assessment, Site Investigation Report dated March 2019, 

Flood Risk Assessment and SuDs Assessment dated June 2019, 

Loss of Employment Land dated June 2019, 

An Archaeological Desk-Based Assessment dated May 2019, 

Delivery and Servicing Statement dated 7th June 2019, 

Preliminary Ecological Appraisal dated 18th March 2019, 

Drainage Assessment Form dated 21st June 2019, 

Air Quality Assessment dated July 2019, 

Financial Viability Assessment dated 15th July 2019, 

D1000, D1100, D1700, D11150 and D1100 Rev 01. Received 19th July 2019. 

Design and Access Statement Addendum dated October 2019, 

Technical NoteTransport response dated 23rd October 2019,

Summary of Areas 6708-D11900 Rev 13, D11150 Rev 02, D11200 Rev 02, D11201 Rev 02, D11203 Rev 02, D11204 Rev 02, D11250 Rev 02, D11500 Rev 02, D11501 Rev 02, D11700 Rev 02, D11701 Rev 02, D11702 Rev 02, D11900, 102527- T-006 Rev A. Received: 24th October 2019

Carbon offset calculation report Appendix A and B. Received: 28/07/2022, Predicted energy assessment, Full SAP calculation printout calculation type: New Build (As designed), Carbon offset calculation report, Fuel poverty document, Energy and sustainability statement. Received: 22/09/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used. 

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission. 
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of materials approved on 07/04/2021 under P/2021/0524 and 17/02/2022 under P/2021/4960.

Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development; in accordance with Local Plan policy CC2. 
Condition : 4 - A) The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of the energy statement approved on 12/12/2023 with legal agreement under P/2022/2426. 

B) Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions. 

Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy 5.2 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ1
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of water efficiency approved on 12/04/2021 under P/2021/0712 and 08/02/2024 under P/2023/3313.

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy 5.15 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ2. 
Condition : 6 - A)	The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of sustainable sourcing of materials approved on 12/04/2021 under P/2021/0712 

B)	The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details under Part A of this condition. 

Reason: in order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with the London Plan Policy 5.3 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development the proposed play space as shown on the submitted plans shall be fully implemented and ready for use and shall be thereafter retained as such without obstruction for the duration of the development. 

Reason. To ensure that adequate play space is provided in line with the London Plan policy 3.6 and the Mayors SPG - Providing for children and young people's play and informal recreation. 
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of contamination approved on 12/05/2021 under P/2021/0960.

Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety. 
Condition : 9 - The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the mitigation measures recommended in the submitted Noise Impact Assessment report and the building shall be constructed so as to provide sound insulation against externally generated noise of not less than the standards outlined in BS8233:2014 (page 24 table 4) with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided. The sound insulation works shall be completed before the building is first occupied or brought into use and retained thereafter. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of future residential properties; in accordance with Local Plan policies CC2 & EQ5. 
Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residents and the amenities of the locality in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and EQ5 and Policies 7.15 (Reducing noise and enhancing soundscapes) and 5.3 (Sustainable design and construction) of the London Plan. 
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the construction management plan approved on 15/03/2021 under P/2021/0209. 

Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved in accordance with policy EC2 of the Local Plan 
Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of privacy screening approved on 07/04/2021 under P/2021/0524.

Reason: In the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with policies CC1 Context and character and CC2 Urban design and architecture of the adopted Local Plan. 
Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of both hard and soft landscaping approved on 07/04/2021 under P/2021/0524.

Reason: In the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with policies CC1 Context and character and CC2 Urban design and architecture of the adopted Local Plan. 
Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of waste and recycling approved on 21/11/2023 under P/2023/0506. 
 
Reason: To ensure the storage areas are suitable to accommodate the number and size of bins required for both uses and in accordance with policy EQ7 (Sustainable waste management) 
Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of cycle stores approved on 15/03/2024 under P/2023/3937.
 
Reason: In accordance with policy 6.9 (Cycle parking) of the London Plan and Local Plan policy EC2 (Developing a sustainable local transport network). 
Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed drainage design approved on 30/05/2022 under P/2021/3650.

Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to London Plan Policy 5.13, its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG, the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Hounslow Council's Local Plan Policy EQ3. 
Condition : 17 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the drainage evidence approved on 03/10/2023 under P/2023/0507. 

Reason: To comply with the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, the National Planning Policy Framework (Paragraph 103), the London Plan (Policies 5.12 and 5.13) along with associated guidance to these policies and Hounslow Council's Local Plan Policy EQ3. 
Condition : 18 - A minimum of three Wheelchair User Dwellings, built to Building Regulations M4(3) standards, shall be provided in accordance with the approved plans. These units shall be retained as such for the duration of the development. 

Reason: To ensure a socially inclusive and sustainable development in accordance with Local Plan Policy SC3 and policies 3.5 (Quality and design of housing developments) and 7.2 (creating an inclusive environment) of the London Plan. 
Condition : 19 - Prior to the occupation of the hereby approved development the parking spaces as shown on the submitted plans shall be made available for use and shall be maintained as such for the duration of the development without obstruction. 

Reason: To ensure parking is provided in line with Local Plan policy EC2 (Developing a sustainable local transport network) and Policy 3.16 (Parking) of the London Plan. 
Condition : 20 - Any boilers installed in the hereby approved development shall be Ultra Low Emissions (<40 mg NOx/kWh) and in accordance with the London Plan Sustainable Design and 
Construction SPG.
 
Reason: To ensure that the development is air quality neutral in accordance with policy EQ4 (Air quality) of the Local Plan and the London Plan.
Condition : 21 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures proposed in the submitted Air Quality Assessment during construction and operational phases. 

Reason: To ensure that there is no adverse impact on air quality in accordance with policy EQ4 (Air quality) of the Local Plan.
Condition : 22 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the parking management plan approved on 15/12/2023 under P/2023/3387.

Reason: To control the level and usage of parking on the site and to support sustainable transport objectives; in accordance with Local Plan policy EC2.
Condition : 23 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of secure by design approved on 28/05/2024 under P/2024/1095.

Reason: In pursuance of the Council's duty under section 17 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998 to consider crime and disorder implications in excising its planning functions; to promote the well-being of the area in pursuance of the Council's powers under section 2 of the Local Government Act 2000 and to ensure the development provides a safe and secure environment in accordance with London Plan (July 2011) Policies 7.1 and 7.3
Condition : 24 - The windows formed in the east elevation of the wider section of block B of the hereby approved development shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing. 

Reason: To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises in accordance with policy SC7 Residential extensions and alterations of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 25 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of boundary treatment approved on 07/04/2021 under P/2021/0524.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the locality and privacy of adjoining properties in accordance with policies CC1 Context and character and CC2 Urban design and architecture of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 26 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved on 15/03/2021 under P/2021/0209 and 20/12/2021 under P/2021/4606.

Reason: To safeguard the archaeological interest of the site.
